=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:1435-1451 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The guard-hook commit tail condition excludes `_gl_resolved` and `_ai_resolved` but not `_mdd_resolved`, so when the modify/delete take-base resolves the last unmerged path after a guard-hook merge, the guard-hook tail calls `_conflict_prepare_commit_deterministic_merge "Guard-hook template merge"` and `exit 0`s (1061-1075) before the modify/delete deferral at 1475-1489 runs.
  WHY: On an `orchestrator/project-*` integration-sync head the `[ai-merge-resolve]` commit is created without the integration fingerprint check, which breaks the fail-closed contract (fix: add `&& [ "${_mdd_resolved:-false}" != "true" ]` at line 1438); all reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:733-734 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The containment `norm()` uses `.strip()`, which also removes trailing whitespace, but the plan says to remove only leading whitespace and the file path.
  WHY: A substantive trailing-whitespace change (for example a Markdown hard break) can match another file's line, so the containment test at 765-770 returns ok, the path is `git rm`'d at 793 and the PR's edit is dropped (fix: `.lstrip()`); severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna said MAJOR, sonnet and glm said NIT, so the highest is used.
- prompts/conflict-resolver.txt:33 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new modify/delete rule (delete, or keep and list the path under "Conflicts resolved:", "see the stage-context block below") is unconditional, while `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED=false` turns off the stage-context append, `_verify_no_unmerged_left` and the keep-file staging (scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:758-763).
  WHY: With the switch off, the model is steered to keep paths that are never staged, so `check_resolver_diff.sh` check (4) fails them with exit_class=scope, and the prompt refers to a block that does not exist, which breaks "Setting the switch to `false` must restore today's behaviour"; severity disagreement: sonnet, gemini and minimax said MAJOR, luna and glm said NIT, so the highest is used.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:1807-1830 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The host-only take-base inline commit posts only `HOST_ONLY_TAKE_BASE_COMMENT_FILE` and `exit 0`s without calling `_conflict_prepare_post_modify_delete_comment`, even when the modify/delete block already took a deletion.
  WHY: On ordinary PR heads the PR's dropped edits are lost silently, because `modify_delete_take_base_comment.md` is never posted and the resolver short-circuits on `CONFLICT_RESOLVED=true`.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:758-763 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_resolver_mdd_enabled` is assigned but never read, and every gate re-parses the environment through `_resolver_mdd_switch_on`.
  WHY: It is dead state that invites drift between the two parsers.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:`_verify_no_unmerged_left` awk section terminator | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The regex `/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z -]*:[[:space:]]*$/` does not end the "Conflicts resolved:" section at headings that contain digits or start with a non-letter, so later bullets are treated as keep declarations.
  WHY: A spurious keep path can be staged unchanged while it is still unmerged; impact is bounded by the RESOLVER_MODIFY_DELETE_PATHS_FILE membership check.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:709-725 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Python containment test spawns one `git diff -U0` subprocess per non-conflicted file, capped at 2000.
  WHY: Large PRs pay serial subprocess latency, and paths past the cap silently lose containment evidence; the fallback (the model gets the conflict) is conservative.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:800 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The exit status of the allowlist rebuild (`git diff ... > "${RESOLVER_ALLOWLIST_FILE}"`) is not checked.
  WHY: A silent failure leaves the allowlist empty or stale, so `_resolver_allowlist_count` reads 0 with no warning.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2828-2834 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In `_resolver_unmerged_left_state`, a `git hash-object --stdin` failure makes the SHA default to "unknown".
  WHY: Two failed objects compare equal in the baseline check, so the verifier can wrongly flag or miss a change.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2858-2864 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In `_resolver_modify_delete_context`, when `git log --diff-filter=D` finds no deletion, `_rmd_by="unknown"` and the prompt reads "deleted on this PR by unknown", which is misleading.
  WHY: A confused model may make an irreversible keep/delete choice the wrong way after a rebase or force-push.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Report dropped edits on the PR: the existing resolver success summary lists each path with its deleting PR and a 10-line excerpt of the dropped diff. That reuses the existing comment; there is no new comment." (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:263), plus step 1 "record it in RESOLVER_DROPPED_EDITS_FILE"
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh, the existing resolver success summary (reading RESOLVER_DROPPED_EDITS_FILE)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: RESOLVER_DROPPED_EDITS_FILE is written at scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:626 and 799 and read nowhere, no hunk extends the existing success summary, and a new `modify_delete_take_base_comment.md` with marker `<!-- ai:modify-delete-take-base:v1 pr=<n> head=<sha> -->` (scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:818-836) is posted by `_conflict_prepare_post_modify_delete_comment` (842-852, called at 1063-1065 and 2176-2178) and by a third take-base loop entry (scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:5461-5476); this is a mechanism deviation, because the content does reach the user.
- requirement: "Move the untouched-unmerged-path check into the soft-validation block as failure kind `unmerged_left`, so it retries with a prompt naming the path."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh, `_capture_unmerged_left_baseline` and `_verify_no_unmerged_left`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Both functions return early unless `IS_WORKFLOW_SOURCE_REPO=true` (lines 2891-2893 and 2917-2919). In consumer repos, `git add -u` at line 5377 stages an untouched modify/delete conflict without the in-loop check or a retry.
- requirement: "Setting the switch to `false` must restore today's behaviour." (linked issue #9886 acceptance)
  expected_change_site: prompts/conflict-resolver.txt:33
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No `{{}}` substitution, template branching or conditional prompt path in scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh strips the rule when `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED=false`.
- requirement: "with leading whitespace and the file path removed" (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:260)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:734, `norm()`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `line[1:].replace(path, "").strip()` strips both sides, and no hunk uses `.lstrip()`.
- requirement: "Keep workflow files under the 480,000-byte guard." (linked issue #9886 acceptance)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (also .github/workflows/ci.yml)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR's Acceptance table marks `tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py` as unmet, and the pre-push gate lists it as an inherited failure. The PR adds env lines without extracting any `run:` bodies, the byte count was not measured, and the cause is unconfirmed. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly skipped this as an inherited failure that also fails on the merge-base.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:lines 1435-1438 (interacts with 465-473, 1475-1488) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The guard-hook tail does not exclude `_mdd_resolved`, so it commits via `_conflict_prepare_commit_deterministic_merge "Guard-hook template merge"` and exits 0 (1061-1075) when modify/delete resolves the last path.
  WHY: The modify/delete deferral (`_det_commit_scope="modify-delete-only"`) and the fingerprint check never run, which breaks the fail-closed integration-sync contract; fix: add `&& [ "${_mdd_resolved:-false}" != "true" ]` at 1438.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:lines 1807-1830 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The host-only take-base inline commit posts only `HOST_ONLY_TAKE_BASE_COMMENT_FILE` and never calls `_conflict_prepare_post_modify_delete_comment`.
  WHY: The dropped modify/delete edits are lost silently on non-integration heads; fix: call it after the commit at 1819 (guarded by `type`, as at 1063).
- prompts/conflict-resolver.txt:line 33 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unconditional modify/delete keep rule and its reference to the stage-context block stay in the prompt when `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED=false`, and `RESOLVER_MODIFY_DELETE_KEEP_FILE` stays empty.
  WHY: `check_resolver_diff.sh` check (4) (lines 222-238) fails a kept path with exit_class=scope, so `false` does not restore today's behaviour.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:inline Python `def norm(line, path)` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `.strip()` also removes trailing whitespace, but the plan (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:260) says leading only.
  WHY: The containment test can return ok for an edit that is not a sweep, and the edit is dropped by `git rm`; the trigger is narrow; fix: `.lstrip()`.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:around lines 758-763 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_resolver_mdd_enabled` is assigned but never read.
  WHY: Dead state that invites parser drift.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: dropped edits must reuse the existing resolver success summary, with no new comment (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:263), and step 1 must record them in `RESOLVER_DROPPED_EDITS_FILE` | Expected change site: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh resolver success summary | Evidence of absence: RESOLVER_DROPPED_EDITS_FILE is written in scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh and read nowhere, and the new `modify_delete_take_base_comment.md` (marker `<!-- ai:modify-delete-take-base:v1 ... -->`) is posted instead | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- HARDENING (2 related items): the take-base results loop `printf '\n#### \`%s\`\n\n' "${_mdd_path}"` lets a backtick in the path inject markdown (strip backticks); and the awk terminator in `_verify_no_unmerged_left` `/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z -]*:[[:space:]]*$/` misses headings with digits (widen to `[A-Za-z0-9 -]*`). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
